description: Toybox 10K: names the specs ask for (new:...) that are made from assets the catalog already has. use = an existing catalog name (critter, character, prop, shape, stage, kind or action); how = what the script does with it. tools/assets10k.mjs reads it.

account_scroll.how: page style scroll; pop it in, then show lines one by one (lines start hidden: hide <id>_l<n> at 0 and pop each)

alphabet_strip.how: card style strip with text "A B C D ... Z" (emphasize one letter to glow it)

answer_page.how: page style letter, lines CLAIM: / QUOTE: / EXPLAIN: (numbers false); stamp = mark result correct

article_page.how: page style article: title = headline, lines = paragraphs, picture + caption, sidebar = boxed note (use a callout for a labeled diagram)

big_book.how: page style book at width ~3.4 on its own; for a cover use a card (style card, picture) in front; turn a page = turn the next page group about y from its left edge (pivot)

bingo_card.how: grid kind 3x3 upright with letter children; found letters get a red sphere sticker; highlight the full line

case_board.how: board, layout pins, labels = the case questions; a solved card gets mark result correct

cast_scroll.how: page style scroll, title CAST OF CHARACTERS, lines = 'NAME: short description'

change_chart.how: board style white, layout columns, labels [START, TURNING POINT, END]; highlight headers in order

chapter_book.how: prop book; chapter title pages as page objects shown when opened

chapter_strip.how: board layout columns, labels [START, MIDDLE, END], easel false, height ~1.2, rows 2

clue_card.how: card style card, picture = ear or eye icon prop (icon_head family) or text EAR / EYE; turn to unfold

comparison_chart.how: board style white, layout columns, labels = the two story names, rows 5

ending_tile.how: card style tile, bg orange, text = -s / -es / -ed / -ing

envelope.how: card style card bg cream with the word as text; fly with path, small wing = two leaf shapes parented

evidence_board.how: board with labels ["who","what","where","when","why","how"], title "EVIDENCE BOARD" (layout pins); cards reparent into <id>_s<k>_1; a wrong card wiggles then drops

how_to_card.how: page style letter: title GOAL..., then lines MATERIALS: ..., 1. ..., 2. ... (numbers true); highlight each step

invitation_card.how: card style card, picture snowflake; opening = turn about y to show a second card with picture igloo

lesson_card.how: card style strip, bg gold, rim gold: text = the lesson sentence

letter_board.how: card style tile bg ink color white; flip with turn and swap text by showing the next card

letter_card.how: card style card, text = one letter (no picture)

letter_plank.how: card style tile, bg wood, width 1.2, one big letter; lay it flat with rotation [-90,0,0] for a bridge plank

letter_tag.how: card style name_tag with one lowercase letter, size 0.6

letter_tile.how: card style tile with one lowercase letter; its capital: a second tile turned [0,180,0] parented behind, or paint/flip

line_card.how: card style strip, text = one poem line

logbook.how: page style book, lines = yesterday's jobs; highlight as read

memory_card.how: card style card with text = the letter; the star back shows when turned [0,180,0] (or put a star shape on its back)

menu_board.how: page style letter, title = cafe name, lines = menu lines

museum_label.how: card style name_tag, bg cream, rim none, one big lowercase letter; wobble with wiggle

name_card.how: card style name_tag (rim none), text = the guest's name, rotation [-15,0,0] like a place card

name_label.how: card style name_tag, text = the name

name_tag.how: card style name_tag, text = the name; blush = paint <id>_back to pink

newsletter.how: page style article; pop it in to 'print'

newsletter_page.how: page style article with the headline as title and the review column as lines

newspaper.how: page style article (headline + short sentences); paint a word via emphasize color red/green

newspaper_page.how: page style article; picture boxes via picture; sentence strips are its lines

notice_board.how: page style letter on an easel-less board: lines = numbered sentences

picture_book_page.how: page style book with picture (the scene) and one or two lines

picture_card.how: card (style card): picture = a prop, critter or shape, text = the word (optional); flip = turn [0,180,0], glow = highlight, wrong = wiggle, slide = move or reparent

poem_scroll.how: page style scroll with numbers: true; lines = poem lines; highlight / emphasize / move to lift

postcard.how: card style strip with picture; the message: a second card on its back, flip with turn

price_tag.how: card style name_tag, rim none, text = one word

punctuation_tiles.how: three cards style tile with text . ? !

question_card.how: card style card, text = the question (picture none); glow with highlight

question_word_cards.how: six cards style card: WHO WHAT WHERE WHEN WHY HOW, bg in six colors

quote_card.how: card style quote, text = the exact quotation, tag = S3 / L2 (its sentence or line number); pins into evidence board sockets

recipe_card.how: page style letter, title = recipe, lines = steps

repair_ticket_board.how: board layout pins, labels = ticket numbers; tickets are cards (style strip), flip with turn and mark correct

script_page.how: page style script: lines like "FOX: Hello!"; highlight one line at a time

sentence_strip.how: card style strip, text = the sentence; emphasize one word in <id>_text; cut = two strips moved apart

shell_card.how: card style card, picture = a shell shape or text only, bg sand

shop_sign.how: card style tile, bg wood, text with a gap; the missing letter is a small tile that moves in

silent_e_card.how: card style tile, text e, bg gold, size 0.7; flips on with turn

snap_card.how: card style card with text or picture

speech_bubble_card.how: prop word_bubble with a text_card child, or card style strip; size from tiny to huge with size

stall_sign.how: card style tile, bg wood, text = the word; droop = turn [0,0,-12]

story_page.how: page style book: lines = numbered sentences; emphasize words in <id>_l<n>, highlight a line, move <id>_l<n> toward the camera to lift it off

summary_card.how: card style quote without tag (bg white), text = the summary; cross out with emphasize color red

syllable_card.how: card style word, text = one syllable; two cards move together to join

t_chart_board.how: board style white, layout columns, two labels; notes are cards (style word or strip) reparented into sockets

theme_card.how: card style strip, bg gold, text = the theme sentence; highlight when proved

think_again_card.how: card style strip: text FIRST I THOUGHT...; a second card behind turned [0,180,0] with NOW I THINK; flip with turn

timeline_board.how: board layout timeline, labels = dates; date markers <id>_t<k> pop and highlight

town_sign.how: prop signpost with a card style strip (1-3 lines) parented to its board

trait_card.how: card style card, text = the trait word, picture = a small icon prop (heart, star)

venn_board.how: board layout venn, labels [left, right, optional both]; sockets s1 left-only, s2 both, s3 right-only

vowel_team_tile.how: card style tile, text = the vowel team (ai, ee...), bg yellow; the ribbon is a small torus shape parented between the letters if needed

weather_board.how: board style white layout pins with labels = days or places; icons are picture cards (picture sun / cloud / rain_cloud / snowflake)

word_card.how: card style word, text = the word

word_tile.how: card style tile, text = one word or letter

word_track_board.how: board style white, layout columns with one label per line (or easel false); word cars are card style word
